title: Zero-downtime RBAC v2 switchover with audit-preserving backfill and per-customer routing
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Execute a zero-downtime migration from RBAC v1 to RBAC v2 that preserves audit fidelity, supports SSO/SAML role mappings, and gives teams per-customer cutover control. We must avoid customer access regressions, maintain a full audit trail (immutable event stream), and provide safe rollback and opt-out windows. Background: RBAC v2 introduces authoritative role store, richer role attributes, and a canonical role ID. Previous migrations caused brief admin lockouts during backfills; this plan combines dual-write, forward-compatible reads, staged reconciliation, and customer routing to avoid that.
acceptance_criteria: Dual-write enabled without >0.5% 5xx increase in auth path across canary customers
Audit events for role changes are written to the new audit stream with original timestamps and preserved actor metadata
Reconciler job (rbac-reconciler) successfully backfills 100% of active accounts in staging with <10 failures per 10k accounts
Per-customer routing flagging works (canary -> ramp -> global) and is controllable from Console/CLI
SAML mapping tests pass for enterprise SSO customers in canary with no loss of mapped roles
Rollback path can restore v1 authoritative reads within 15 minutes and replay audit events to v1 ledger
tasks: Implement dual-write layer: writes to v1 authoritative store + v2 canonical store with idempotency tokens
Expose feature flag in Console and CLI for per-customer routing and manual override
Build rbac-reconciler: incremental backfill tool with throttling, retry, and dead-letter queue
Add audit-forwarder that copies v1 audit events into the v2 immutable event stream with signature metadata
Create a synthetic dry-run harness (1000 synthetic orgs) to validate backfill semantics and SSO mappings
Add dashboard: migration-progress, reconciliation-failures, auth-5xx-rate, avg-latency, mismatch-rate
Define and test rollback automation and manual runbook steps, include time-to-restore metric
Prepare customer communications templates and admin opt-out flow in Console
Coordinate security review and compliance sign-off for audit retention and KMS usage
Run canary: 5% of traffic for 48h, ramp to 25% for 24h, evaluate metrics, then global cutover
